summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of DeployrAI landing page. All core features working correctly including header, hero section, video cards grid, hover effects, modal functionality, responsive design, and keyboard navigation.
passed_tests: Header loads with DeployrAI logo, navigation links (Proof, Features, About), and 'Get Early Access' CTA
Hero section displays VibeCon badge, 'DeployAI Agents at Scale' headline, subtext, and CTA buttons
Output Proof Section shows 'Built With the System' title with pre-title and subtitle
6 video cards render correctly in 3-column grid on desktop
Each video card displays thumbnail image, tag label, and title text
Video card hover effects work: card lifts up, border glows purple, play button appears
Clicking video card opens modal overlay with video content
Modal displays video title, tag, and placeholder content correctly
Close button (X) successfully closes the modal
Enter key on focused video card opens modal
Footer displays with logo and social links (Twitter, GitHub, LinkedIn)
Navigation links work correctly - 'See the Proof' and header 'Proof' link scroll to Output Proof Section
Responsive design works on tablet (768px) and mobile (390px) viewports
Scroll indicator with floating animation displays correctly
Trust line displays at bottom of Output Proof Section
All animations work: fade-in-up on scroll, floating scroll indicator
